## Net sales figure.
The "Consolidated Statements of Earnings" is on page 50. Net sales for fiscal year 2023 come to $1,558,829 thousand.

## Cash from operations.
Page 53 has the "CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF CASH FLOWS." Net cash provided by operating activities for the period ended September 30, 2023 is $172,279 thousand.

## Capital expenditures.
Still on page 53, the Investing Activities section. Purchases of property, plant, and equipment for September 30, 2023 amount to $104,737 thousand.

## Free cash flow calculation.
$172,279 thousand minus $104,737 thousand. That comes to $67,542 thousand.

## Free cash flow margin.
$67,542 divided by $1,558,829 then times 100. The result is 4.33%.

## Data source.
Annual Report 2024. Income Statement is page 113. Statement of Financial Position is page 114. Numbers in DKK million.

## Net profit for Carlsberg A/S shareholders.
From the Income Statement on page 113: profit for 2024 is DKK 9,116 million. This excludes non-controlling interests of DKK 1,147 million from the DKK 10,263 million total.

## Shareholders equity values.
From page 114: equity for shareholders in Carlsberg A/S is DKK 27,771 million at end of 2024. At end of 2023 it was DKK 23,234 million.

## Average equity.
27,771 and 23,234 summed is 51,005. 51,005 divided by 2 gives 25,502.5.

## ROE.
9,116 divided by 25,502.5 equals 0.3574551515. Multiplied by 100 gives 35.74551515%.

## Formula.
Fixed Asset Turnover equals Net Revenue divided by Net Property, Plant, and Equipment.

## Revenue figure.
Page 71 has the "Consolidated Statements of Income." Total revenues for the year ended December 31, 2023 are $14,984 million. Values are in millions.

## PP&E figure.
Page 73 has the "Consolidated Balance Sheets." Property and equipment, net is listed under noncurrent assets. At December 31, 2023 the value is $1,523 million.

## Ratio calculation.
$14,984 million divided by $1,523 million equals 9.84. The fixed asset turnover ratio for IQVIA for the year ended December 31, 2023 is 9.84.

## Revenue source.
Page 14. The "Consolidated Statements of Operations" is there. Total revenue for fiscal year 2023: 1,058.581 million.

## Cost of subscription services.
Still page 14. Cost of subscription services revenue for fiscal year 2023: 87.366 million.

## The math.
87.366 divided by 1,058.581 then times 100.

## Finding the section.
Page 12. The "Electric Energy Sources" section is there. It has donut charts and bar graphs for energy generation data, year ended December 31, 2023.

## Two charts to read.
The page has a "2023 Energy Mix - NSP System" donut chart. It also has a "2023 Energy Mix - SPS" donut chart.

## Carbon-free numbers.
NSP System donut chart: 64% carbon free. SPS donut chart: 37% carbon free.

## Difference.
64 minus 37 equals 27. The difference is 27%.

## Where the data is.
Page 41 has the EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation table. Units are thousands.

## Adjusted EBITDA.
2024 Adjusted EBITDA in the table is 104,840 thousand.

## Interest expense.
2024 interest expense in the same table is 7,822 thousand.

## Division result.
104,840 over 7,822. That equals 13.40.

## The table.
"5. Accrued Expenses" table is on page 122. For 2024: accrued professional fees $1,273 thousand, accrued license fees $3,300 thousand, total $7,496 thousand.

## How much gets paid.
$2,000 thousand payment is more than the $1,273 thousand professional fees balance. Only $1,273 thousand can be paid off.

## New total.
$7,496 minus $1,273. That is $6,223 thousand.

## Percentage.
$3,300 divided by $6,223 is 0.5302908565. As a percentage: 53.02908565%.

## Page 109.
The "Accrued Expenses" table is on page 109. December 31, 2024 accrued compensation: $5,154 thousand. Total accrued expenses: $13,074 thousand.

## New compensation balance.
$5,154 minus $500 is $4,654 thousand.

## New total expenses.
$13,074 minus $500 is $12,574 thousand.

## Percentage result.
$4,654 divided by $12,574 then times 100. That is 37.01288%.

## Locate the chart.
Page 33 has the "Cumulative Total Stockholder Return" table. It shows cumulative return percentages for AAOI, the NASDAQ Telecom Index, and the NASDAQ Composite Index by year-end.

## AAOI return in 2020.
The "12/31/2020" row under the "AAOI" column shows a cumulative return of 71.63%.

## AAOI return in 2023.
The "12/31/2023" data point under the "AAOI" column shows a cumulative return of 162.63%.

## Percentage increase.
162.63% minus 71.63% equals 91.00%. The increase from 2020 to 2023 is 91.00%.

## Revenue figure.
Page 109, "Statement of Profit or Loss for the Year Ended 31 December 2023." Revenue: SAR 3,196,966,537.

## Net profit figure.
Same statement, page 109. PROFIT FOR THE YEAR: SAR 302,064,771.

## Both in same units.
Revenue and profit are both in full SAR values. No conversion needed.

## 2024 projected revenue.
SAR 3,196,966,537 times 1.10 equals SAR 3,516,663,190.70.

## Answer.
Projected 2024 net profit is SAR 332,271,248.1.

## Foreign currency translation adjustment.
Page 52 has the "CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF COMPREHENSIVE INCOME (LOSS)." The "Foreign currency translation adjustments, net of tax" value for 2024 is ($32,910) thousand. Values are in thousands.

## Adjusted translation adjustment with 25% increase.
The 25% increase in losses means multiplying ($32,910) by 1.25. ($32,910) times 1.25 equals ($41,137.5) thousand.

## Other components that stay constant.
Net income for 2024 on page 52: $251,598 thousand. Foreign defined benefit plan adjustments for 2024: $398 thousand.

## New total other comprehensive loss.
($41,137.5) thousand plus $398 thousand equals ($40,739.5) thousand.

## Adjusted total comprehensive income.
$251,598 thousand plus ($40,739.5) thousand equals $210,858.5 thousand. Rounded to the nearest thousand that is $210,859 thousand.

## Total assets and current assets.
Page 86 has the "Consolidated Balance Sheets." For December 31, 2023: total assets are $470,114 thousand and current assets are $219,329 thousand. Values are in thousands except share data.

## Adjusted total assets.
Current assets increase by 10%. 10% of $219,329 thousand equals $21,932.9 thousand. New total assets: $470,114 plus $21,932.9 equals $492,046.9 thousand.

## Stockholders equity.
The same table on page 86 shows total stockholders equity at $387,881 thousand for 2023.

## Units.
All values are in thousands. No conversion needed.

## Equity-to-assets ratio.
$387,881 divided by $492,046.9 equals 0.7883. Multiplied by 100 the ratio is 78.83%.

## The performance graph.
"COMPARISON OF 5 YEAR CUMULATIVE TOTAL RETURN" is on page 47. Covers 2018-2023. Starts at $100 with reinvested dividends.

## Three lines shown.
Prologis Inc. Separate lines for S&P 500 Stock Index and FTSE Nareit Equity REITs Index.

## Values at December 2023.
Prologis: $257.08. S&P 500: $207.21.

## Difference.
$257.08 minus $207.21. Answer: $49.87.

## Historical cash flow values.
Page 94 of the 10-K has the operating activities cash flow data. For 2020: $74.8M. For 2021: $63.2M. For 2022: $(104.8)M. Values are in millions.

## Normalize 2022.
$50M of the 2022 outflow was a one-time tax item. Remove it: $(104.8)M plus $50M equals $(54.8)M normalized 2022 cash flow.

## Three-year average.
Sum: $74.8M plus $63.2M plus $(54.8)M equals $83.2M. Average: $83.2M divided by 3 equals $27.73M.

## Apply 10% growth.
$27.73M times 1.10 equals $30.5 million. The adjusted operating cash flow projection for 2023 is $30.5 million.
